desc: A kept seat is its own controller's: player 2 joins by Start on pad 2, pad 2 is unplugged (the seat kept), then pad 3, the same model (one GUID, no serial in common), is plugged in and Aurora puts it in port 2 by the saved port: it doesn't play by being there (its A does nothing) until its own Start joins it. Without the check it played at once, a stranger's or a handheld's pad in the kept seat
log_must: \[seats\] 600: port 1 pad 1, port 2 pad 2; player 2 plays; 2 playing
\[coop\] player 2's controller disconnected: their seat is kept
\[coop\] controller 2 isn't the one player 2's seat is kept for
\[seats\] 760: port 1 pad 1, port 2 pad 3; player 2 nobody
\[seats\] 820: port 1 pad 1, port 2 pad 3; player 2 nobody
\[seats\] 940: port 1 pad 1, port 2 pad 3; player 2 plays; 2 playing
